descriptionHtml:
**Gamdias Aura GL360 Liquid Cooler**


**Brand:** Gamdias

**Model:** Aura GL360

**Type:** All-in-One (AIO) Liquid CPU Cooler

**Radiator Size:** 360mm


---


**Radiator Specifications:**

- **Dimensions:** 394 x 120 x 27 mm

- **Material:** Aluminum

- **Tube Length:** 400 mm

- **Tube Material:** Rubber with nylon mesh


---


**Water Block (CPU Block):**

- **Dimensions:** 86 x 72 x 56 mm

- **Material:** Copper (base plate)

- **Pump Speed:** 2400 ± 10% RPM

- **Pump Noise Level:** < 28 dBA

- **Pump Power Connector:** 3-pin

- **RGB Lighting:** Addressable RGB (ARGB) on pump top


---


**Fans (3 x 120mm):**

- **Fan Model:** Gamdias Aura GL120

- **Fan Dimensions:** 120 x 120 x 25 mm

- **Fan Speed:** 600 - 2000 RPM (± 10%)

- **Airflow:** Up to 72 CFM (per fan)

- **Static Pressure:** Up to 2.65 mmH₂O

- **Noise Level:** < 32 dBA

- **Bearing Type:** Hydraulic bearing

- **Fan Connector:** 4-pin PWM

- **RGB Connector:** 3-pin ARGB (5V)

- **RGB Lighting:** Addressable RGB on fan blades


---


**Compatibility (Sockets):**


| Brand | Compatible Sockets |

| :--- | :--- |

| **Intel** | LGA 1700, LGA 1200, LGA 115X (1150, 1151, 1155, 1156), LGA 2066, LGA 2011 |

| **AMD** | AM5, AM4, AM3+, AM3, AM2+, AM2, FM2+, FM2, FM1 |


---


**Technical Specifications:**

- **Cooling Type:** Liquid (water + anti-corrosion additive)

- **Power Consumption (Pump):** 2.4W - 3.6W

- **Power Consumption (Fans):** 2.4W (each fan)

- **Rated Voltage (Pump):** 12V DC

- **Rated Voltage (Fan):** 12V DC

- **Rated Voltage (RGB):** 5V DC


---


**Features:**

- 360mm radiator for maximum cooling performance

- Addressable RGB lighting on both pump and fans

- PWM controlled fans for automatic speed adjustment

- Universal compatibility with Intel and AMD sockets

- Anti-leak technology

- Nylon mesh reinforced tubes for durability

- Hydraulic bearing fans for quiet operation


---


**Package Includes:**

- Gamdias Aura GL360 liquid cooler

- 3 x 120mm Aura GL120 ARGB fans (pre-installed on radiator)

- Mounting kit for Intel and AMD sockets

- Thermal paste (pre-applied or included)

- User manual

- RGB controller hub 


---


**Notes:**

- The Aura GL360 is designed for high-performance CPUs (Intel Core i9 / AMD Ryzen 9)

- ARGB lighting requires a 5V 3-pin RGB header on the motherboard

- Some versions may include a dedicated RGB controller for motherboards without ARGB headers
